503:t_014:9.en:
$$リディ$$
「I...am prepared to bear any disgrace if it means protecting the world!」

503:t_016:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「I won't let you go, $$ヒイロ$$!」

503:t_017:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
「That guy! He's being far too reckless!」

503:t_017:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「That's far enough, $$ヒイロ$$. And you, $c.」

503:t_017:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「If you want $$リリーナ・ピースクラフト$$ released, come with me.」

503:t_017:5.en:
$$五飛$$
「You're telling us to submit to $$クロノ$$?」

503:t_017:8.en:
$$リディ$$
「I told you, $$バナージ$$. I'm prepared to do this.」

503:t_017:9.en:
$$リディ$$
「For that purpose, I'll use any means, even if people call me a coward.」

503:t_017:10.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$リディ$$... What does $$クロノ$$ intend to do once it absorbs us?」

503:t_017:11.en:
$$リディ$$
「First, we will defeat $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

503:t_017:13.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$ of $$ネオ・ジオン$$ intends to obtain $$ラプラスの箱$$...in other words, $$クロノ$$'s doctrine, and take its place.」

503:t_017:14.en:
$$リディ$$
「But we cannot permit that. $$クロノ$$ does not acknowledge the existence of $$スペースノイド$$s.」

503:t_017:15.en:
$$キラ$$
「Please come to your senses, Ensign $$リディ$$! Aren't those the very people we've been fighting!?」

503:t_017:16.en:
$$リディ$$
「I knew nothing back then... But now it's different...」

503:t_017:17.en:
$$リディ$$
「I've encountered the truth. This $$バンシィ$$ is proof of that.」

503:t_017:18.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What on earth are you saying, Ensign $$リディ$$!?」

503:t_017:19.en:
$$リディ$$
「I have no intention of talking to you any further. Come with me, $c.」

503:t_017:20.en:
$$リディ$$
「If you refuse, I'll kill $$リリーナ・ピースクラフト$$.」

503:t_017:25.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$リリーナ$$... I'll kill you.」

503:t_019:1.en:
$$トロワ$$
「But that ship...hasn't taken any damage.」

503:t_019:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「It's just like the battle in $$ブリュッセル$$, $$ヒイロ$$.」

503:t_019:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「I thought you'd kill $$リリーナ・ピースクラフト$$ with your own hands rather than let anyone use her.」

503:t_020:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「It's useless. I anticipated that and gave that ship the highest level of anti-beam defenses.」

503:t_020:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「Escort force! Shoot down that $$ガンダム$$!」

503:t_022:0.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Fall back, $$ヒイロ$$! You'll only get worn down like this!」

503:t_022:3.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「It's just like when he self-destructed in the $$ゴビ砂漠$$... He...intends to throw away his life!」

503:t_022:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Taking the life of the person you cherish most...is the same as throwing away your own life...」

503:t_022:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「What are you doing!? Stop him! Fire!!」

503:t_023:1.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Shoot, $$ヒイロ$$! Come and kill me!」

503:t_024:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「If he keeps firing the $$バスターライフル$$ with that much damage, his machine won't hold out!」

503:t_024:1.en:
$$五飛$$
「But even so, $$ヒイロ$$ won't stop.」

503:t_024:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「Why...!? Why won't he give up!?」

503:t_024:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$リディ$$! You're not the only one fighting with resolve!」
